what_it_is: Targeted gene and curated-panel reads in the two READABLE EMC array series - GSE24369 on GPL6244 (6 EMC vs 29 comparator sarcomas) and GSE4303 on GPL3290 (10 vs 6). Nine reads; read_8_SURFACE_ANTIGEN is the surface-antigen one, and it carries a per-gene cross_platform_board over 100 genes.
control_note: reads.control reads NR4A3, ENO3 and MKI67 - two genes that must be up and one that must be flat - on these exact platforms before any antigen is read. A control licenses reading the other rows and nothing more.
limits: Two platforms with different physics; GPL3290 is two-colour log-ratio against a reference pool, so an absolute level there is not a statement that a gene is expressed.
Different comparator arms between the two series, so a single-platform move is a lead and not a replication.
Bulk archival tissue, not deconvolved - a stromal or matrix antigen can read high because the compartment is present.
No multiple-testing correction anywhere, by design; every t and df is reported.
READABILITY IS AN INSTRUMENT STATE, NEVER A LOW READING. Genes unreadable on a platform carry READABLE_ON_ONE_PLATFORM_ONLY or NOT_READABLE_ON_EITHER_PLATFORM and must never be reported as negative.

what_it_is: The ONLY deposit reachable at $0 that carries EMC libraries alongside NORMAL tissue. 19 genes, n = 4 EMC, 27 normal-organ libraries and 32 non-EMC sarcoma libraries on 3SEQ. Its canonical interpretation is research/manuscripts/gse28866-tumour-vs-normal-reading.md, which is canonical_for it.
control_note: NR4A3 is detected in the EMC arm and its median across the 32 other sarcomas is zero - the fusion's own 3' partner behaving as the disease definition requires, in a cohort this repository did not choose. A control, not a result.
limits: n = 4 EMC. Medians of four libraries: no confidence interval, no test, no distribution.
3' end read density is NOT array intensity and must NEVER be pooled with GPL6244/GPL3290.
Several genes rest on a SINGLE PEAK - CSPG4, FAP, GPC3, L1CAM, PRAME among them; n_peaks is in the artifact for this reason.

TWO AXES, NEVER ONE. The 27 normals are visceral organs with almost no soft tissue in them, so the normal arm is an on-target/off-tumour EXPOSURE axis and NOT a lineage-specificity axis; the 32-sarcoma arm is the lineage axis. Reading either as the other is the error this artifact's reading memo exists to prevent.
The normals are a tissue panel, not matched adjacent tissue, and six organs are not a body.
Transcript only. No protein, no surface localisation, no safety statement, no therapeutic-window statement.

produced_by: research/manuscripts/endpoint_corpus.py (stdlib only, CPU, $0; --check re-derives from the literature-cache extraction and refuses to write on drift)
note: The arm-level corpus the cross-disease endpoint paper rests on: every ClinicalTrials.gov study whose posted results carry a complete four-cell best-response table, reduced to one row per arm. The inclusion unit is an ARM and there is no disease-level criterion, so a condition enters the corpus only by having a trial that reported the four cells. It also records why abstracts were screened and not used, which is the reason the corpus is smaller than the literature.

The re-read itself: per-arm objective response and disease control on one denominator, their difference as the stable-disease proportion with an exact Wilson interval, the distribution of that gap across the corpus, a census of how many screened studies post results without the four cells, and the share of arms whose response readout returned zero events. EMC enters as one labelled row in that distribution rather than as the subject.

Each condition placed on two coordinates - plausible response rate and accruable arm size - with the two boundaries drawn as level sets of the binomial: the sample size at which a single-stage design against a 5 percent null is defined, and the size at which one response is more likely than not. A condition whose median response is at or below the null has NO defined design and is counted separately rather than folded into the denominator, which is the correction that moved the headline share from 31.8 to 50.0 percent.

What the corpus holds by way of a comparator: arms carrying a control token in title or registered type, classified only where the title and the registered arm type AGREE, and the count of low-response conditions that have no control arm at all. The classification is deliberately conservative in both directions after it passed a placebo-plus-active-backbone arm on names alone and then passed an active arm on a sibling arm group's registered type.

The necessity check, and the finding that reframed the paper: oncology has already solved this problem four separate times across 12 disease domains, the earliest in 1998. The remedy is therefore DIFFUSION rather than invention, and the audit's own gap section counts how many low-response conditions still have no endorsed alternative. Assignments are labelled as judgements read from retrieved records, not as an exhaustive survey.
